plain_english_policy: This bill extends the life of a specific state commission by one year. The policy direction is to allow this existing group, which studies public-private partnerships (P-3) for infrastructure projects, more time to finish its work and implement recommendations from an earlier report before it officially dissolves.
policy_direction_if_enacted: The Lieutenant Governor's Commission on Public-Private Partnership Projects will continue operating until the fifth legislative day of the 2011 Regular Session. During this extension, the commission is authorized to conduct informational briefings with P-3 experts and implement recommendations from its original report submitted in 2009.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors support extending the commission's existence to facilitate further study and implementation of public-private partnership initiatives.
evidence_quotes: "That the Lieutenant Governor's Commission on Public-Private Partnership Projects continue with implementation of the recommendations included in its original report to the Legislature"
"and that the commission be extended until the fifth legislative day of the 2011 Regular Session of the Alabama Legislature."
